summary.methods: 将 VICReg 风格目标实例化为时间相邻正例加未微分总体统计，得到有界状态的在线损失；梯度对应前馈权重的 Hebbian 更新和每层侧矩阵的 anti-Hebbian 更新。在类分块 MNIST 流上训练两层全连接网络，批大小为 1。
summary.relevance: 关联自监督与表示学习，以及局部学习规则和在线持续学习。
summary.caveat: 作者明确目标是在小网络上验证规则可行性而非与反向传播竞争；摘要仅报告 MNIST 流上的线性探针结果，未覆盖更大网络、复杂数据或与其他局部规则的系统比较。

papers.title: Time Flies When You Parallelise: Pareto-efficient Time Series Foundation Models with Linear Recurrences
papers.abstract: Time series foundation models have demonstrated strong zero-shot forecasting performance, but computational efficiency remains a central architectural challenge. Temporal self-attention incurs quadratic cost in the number of temporal tokens, while nonlinear recurrent state transitions restrict parallel computation along the temporal dimension. We introduce ci-proto, a family of time series foundation models based on Mamba-3, whose linear state recurrences support chunk-wise parallel-in-time computation during training, and inference costs that scale linearly with sequence length. The architecture alternates recurrent temporal processing with cross-variate attention, supporting multivariate probabilistic forecasting with past-only and future-known covariates. Across fev-bench's 100 forecasting tasks, ci-proto XL sets a new state of the art among time series foundation models. The five ci-proto variants also make up the entire Pareto frontier for mean scaled quantile loss and mean absolute scaled error against both parameter count and median runtime.

summary.takeaway: 提出基于 Mamba-3 线性递归的时间序列基础模型系列 ci-proto，在保持零样本预测性能的同时实现分块并行训练和线性推理成本。
summary.methods: 交替使用递归时间处理与跨变量注意力，支持含过去已知和未来已知协变量的多变量概率预测；在 fev-bench 的 100 个预测任务上评估，并与参数数量和运行时间比较。
summary.relevance: 关联预训练时间序列基础模型的架构效率与 Pareto 前沿。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告 ci-proto XL 在 fev-bench 上达到新的最优，并称五个变体构成 Pareto 前沿，但未给出具体误差数值、统计检验或基准之外任务的泛化结果。

papers.title: Visual Cipher Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract: While language-model agents excel at long-horizon coding and terminal tasks, this success relies on two conditions: explicit text specifications and immediate execution feedback. However, neither condition holds in real-world problems where critical information exists only in images, leaving it unclear whether long-horizon capability transfers from text to visual reasoning. In such visual settings, because rules and clues resist text transcription and lack test-case feedback, agents must repeatedly inspect images, simulate spatial transformations, and autonomously cross-check clues. Despite this challenge, existing evaluations fail to capture such capability: visual reasoning benchmarks largely reduce tasks to single-turn, short-chain question answering, whereas agent benchmarks focus on text-based environments or interactive states that permit trial-and-error. To bridge this gap, we introduce Visual Cipher Bench, a collection of 40 original visual puzzles across four categories: spatial manipulation and simulation, logical constraints and planning, rule induction, and knowledge-based decoding. Each puzzle provides only one to three black-and-white line drawings and a minimal submission instruction, requiring agents to discover the underlying solving mechanism entirely from the images. Across 29 reasoning-effort configurations of eight frontier models, even the strongest model, GPT-6 Astra (max), achieves only 26.7% accuracy, while five of the eight models score below 1%. Yet on a ten-task subset, providing a single non-spoiler mechanism hint boosts accuracy from 7.8% to 55.6%. This sharp contrast shows that the primary bottleneck of current agents lies not in executing multi-step plans, but in autonomously discovering rules from visual evidence. Visual Cipher Bench thus provides a rigorous benchmark for measuring long-horizon visual reasoning in agents.

summary.takeaway: 提出 Visual Cipher Bench，用于评估 LLM agent 在仅有图像、缺乏文本规范和即时反馈条件下的长程视觉推理；最强模型准确率仅 26.7%，表明主要瓶颈在于自主从图像中发现规则，而非执行多步计划。
summary.methods: 构建 40 道原创视觉谜题，覆盖空间操作与模拟、逻辑约束与规划、规则归纳、知识解码四类；每道题仅给 1–3 幅黑白线稿和极简提交说明，要求 agent 完全从图像中发现解题机制；对 8 个前沿模型的 29 种推理强度配置进行评估。
summary.relevance: 该基准直接评测大语言模型作为 agent 的长程推理能力，并揭示文本环境中的长程能力难以迁移到视觉场景，与“大语言模型”主题高度相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅给出总体准确率和单条提示子集上的提升，未说明各模型、各类别谜题的具体结果；基准规模为 40 题，题目难度与覆盖范围的代表性需进一步验证。

papers.title: Large Language Models as Digital Twins: a Distribution-Aware Questionnaire-Based Evaluation
papers.abstract: This paper investigates whether Large Language Models can answer a personality questionnaire as a specific individual would. Given a user's social-media posts, the model completes the BFI-2-60 Big Five questionnaire as that user. The predicted responses are converted into trait scores and compared with the user's actual scores. We evaluate GPT-4, Gemma, Llama 3.1, and Mistral on the MyPersonality dataset. To determine whether predictions reflect information from the user's writing, we compare them with answers produced without user text and with values derived from general population tendencies. We measure prediction error across all users and separately for individuals with low, intermediate, and high trait scores. We also test whether an LLM can express an explicit personality profile when given only the target Big Five scores, without user text, and examine how predictions change as more text is provided. The results show that user text does not consistently improve performance. Models perform better near the middle of the trait distribution, while at the lower and upper ends they often remain close to central values or perform well at one end but poorly at the other. When given an explicit profile, GPT-4 most clearly translates trait information into consistent questionnaire responses, particularly for Extraversion and Neuroticism. Increasing context does not systematically reduce error: open-source models fluctuate more, whereas GPT-4 remains comparatively stable. Overall, the evaluated models do not consistently reproduce the questionnaire behavior of specific individuals.

summary.takeaway: 评估 LLM 能否根据用户社交媒体文本模拟该用户的 BFI-2-60 人格问卷作答；结果显示用户文本并未稳定提升预测，模型在特质分布两端表现较差，整体无法一致复现特定个体的问卷行为。
summary.methods: 在 MyPersonality 数据集上，向 GPT-4、Gemma、Llama 3.1、Mistral 提供用户社交媒体帖子，令其完成 BFI-2-60 问卷，并将预测得分与用户真实得分比较；设置无用户文本、基于总体倾向的对照，并按低、中、高特质分层分析误差；另测试仅给定目标 Big Five 分数时模型能否生成一致的问卷回答，以及增加文本量对预测的影响。
summary.relevance: 该研究考察大语言模型对个体心理特征的建模与对齐能力，涉及用户文本条件化、分布偏差和人格模拟，与“大语言模型”主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体误差数值和统计显著性；MyPersonality 数据集的代表性有限，且社交媒体文本与问卷作答之间的映射本身存在不确定性。

papers.title: From Large Language Models to Efficient System One Models via Adaptive Computation
papers.abstract: Transferring LLMs into System One decision models typically replaces the language modeling head with a decision head while retaining the full backbone, making every decision pay for all layers. Yet it remains unclear how much depth such decisions require. We find that decision information is concentrated in intermediate layers, with early layers building essential features and the final six layers removable without loss, while independently trained smaller models largely mimic the full model rather than developing specialized decision capabilities. These findings suggest that efficiency requires not simply smaller backbones, but shared computation across different depths. Building on this, we propose \method{}, which jointly trains a full model with prefix sub-models that share its final layers and decision head through self-distillation. A lightweight gate reads the hidden state at each exit to determine whether additional computation is needed, allowing one model to operate at multiple layers. Across seven decision benchmarks, our approach matches or outperforms independently trained models at every depth, while achieving better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs through adaptive computation.

summary.takeaway: 发现决策信息集中在 LLM 中间层，移除最后六层不损失性能；提出通过共享深层计算和自适应门控，使一个模型可在多个深度运行，在七个决策基准上匹配或超过各深度独立训练的模型，并取得更好的准确率—效率权衡。
summary.methods: 分析决策信息在各层的分布，并比较独立训练的小模型与完整模型；在此基础上联合训练完整模型与共享最后若干层和决策头的前缀子模型，采用自蒸馏和轻量门控读取各出口隐状态以决定是否继续计算；在七个决策基准上评估。
summary.relevance: 该工作研究如何将大语言模型高效转化为 System One 决策模型，涉及模型深度利用、自适应计算和自蒸馏，与“大语言模型”主题直接相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明七个决策基准的具体构成、模型规模和计算开销细节；门控机制在不同任务分布上的泛化能力尚不明确。

papers.title: Indic-Task Gains and Regressions after Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: We run reinforcement learning (RL) with GRPO across four environments, starting from a supervised fine-tuned 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts model covering English and eight Indic languages. We compare the model before and after RL across 34 benchmarks in one evaluation campaign. MATH improves by 36.07 points, and most Indic benchmarks also improve. Yet XQuAD-Indic F1 falls 19.32 points as English answers rise from 8.7% to 91.7%; IndicQA falls 8.64, while English XQuAD gains 11.71 F1. A second RL run from the same supervised initialization adds an Indic environment together with language and repetition rewards. Compared with the released model, it improves both passage-answering and instruction-following benchmarks, along with preserving MATH performance. But it loses ground on reasoning and coding benchmarks. Several training choices changed together, so we cannot isolate the effect of any one of the reward terms. Script compliance remains unresolved. Adding a language reward did not ensure use of the requested script. Passage answering and script compliance therefore need direct evaluation, even when other benchmark scores improve.

summary.takeaway: 对覆盖英语和八种 Indic 语言的 30B-A3B MoE 模型进行 GRPO 强化学习后发现，MATH 大幅提升且多数 Indic 基准改善，但部分 Indic 问答基准显著下降并出现语言漂移；加入 Indic 环境和语言、重复奖励的第二次 RL 改善了问答和指令遵循，却在推理与编码基准上退步，且未解决文字脚本合规问题。
summary.methods: 从监督微调的 30B-A3B MoE 模型出发，在四个环境中用 GRPO 进行 RL，并在一次评测中比较 RL 前后模型在 34 个基准上的表现；第二次 RL 从同一监督初始化出发，加入 Indic 环境及语言奖励和重复奖励，并与已发布模型比较。
summary.relevance: 该研究直接考察强化学习对大语言模型多语言任务表现的影响及增益与回退，与“强化学习”主题高度相关。
summary.caveat: 多个训练选择同时改变，无法分离各奖励项的作用；摘要未给出完整基准列表和统计细节，文字脚本合规问题仍未解决。

papers.title: Assessing the Capacity of Genomic Language Models to Generate Informative Embeddings of Viral Genome Fragments
papers.abstract: Genomic language models (gLMs) trained on large volumes of nucleotide sequences are becoming an alternative to classical methods in metagenomic analysis, particularly for studying genomic "dark matter". In this work, we investigate the ability of four gLMs (DNABERT-2, DNABERT-S, ViraLM, and Evo2-7B) to generate taxonomically informative vector representations of short viral genome fragments. We constructed a balanced reference dataset of viruses based on the ICTV Virus Metadata Resource and compared the representations generated by gLMs with conventional k-mer profiles and MinHash sketches using clustering and neighborhood-based metrics (adjusted Rand index (ARI), precision@k, and CROSS precision@k). On the reference dataset, three of the four gLMs outperformed the 4-mer profile in terms of ARI and precision@5 under the same evaluation protocol. The best performance was generally achieved by intermediate model layers. Conventional k-mer profiles consistently outperformed MinHash sketches. We further evaluated the methods on two viral orders (egoviruses and mriyaviruses) absent from the reference dataset, with model layers and k-mer lengths selected exclusively on the reference dataset. DNABERT-S showed the most consistently strong performance across these two orders, ranking first on mriyaviruses and second on egoviruses, while k-mer profiles with Jensen-Shannon distance remained competitive. We also observed the consistency of representations between forward fragments and their reverse complements. Overall, the best-performing gLMs surpassed conventional baselines, although their advantage depended on the dataset and evaluation metric. The consistently strong performance of DNABERT-S suggests a potential benefit of contrastive fine-tuning and indicates that larger models are not necessarily more effective for generating taxonomically informative representations.

summary.takeaway: 系统评估四种基因组语言模型为短病毒基因组片段生成分类学信息嵌入的能力；在参考数据集上，四种模型中有三种在 ARI 和 precision@5 上优于 4-mer 基线，中间层表现最佳，DNABERT-S 在两个未见于参考集的病毒目上表现最稳定。
summary.methods: 基于 ICTV Virus Metadata Resource 构建平衡病毒参考数据集，比较 DNABERT-2、DNABERT-S、ViraLM、Evo2-7B 的表示与 k-mer 谱和 MinHash sketch，采用聚类和邻域指标（ARI、precision@k、CROSS precision@k）；在参考集上选择模型层和 k-mer 长度后，在 egoviruses 和 mriyaviruses 两个未见于参考集的病毒目上评估，并检查正向片段与反向互补序列表示的一致性。
summary.relevance: 该工作评估基因组语言模型作为嵌入表示用于宏基因组分类和“暗物质”研究，与检索增强与对齐主题中表示学习和模型评估相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体指标数值；优势依赖数据集和评价指标，参考数据集规模与病毒多样性覆盖未知，且仅评估短片段场景。

papers.title: Leveraging state-of-the-art AI structure predictors to generate atomic resolution ensembles of intrinsically disordered proteins
papers.abstract: Intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) are central to many biological processes, but their function depends on dynamic conformational ensembles rather than a single structure. Despite the impact of artificial intelligence on protein structure prediction, determining these ensembles at atomistic resolution remains challenging. Recently, we introduced bAIes, a framework that leverages the structural information encoded in AlphaFold2 distograms to generate conformational ensembles of IDPs at atomistic resolution. Here, we extend this framework to six state-of-the-art structure prediction tools (AlphaFold2, AlphaFold3, Boltz-1, Boltz-2, ESMFold, and ESMFold2) and systematically compare the structural information encoded in their predicted inter-residue distance distributions. Despite differences between predictors, we show that bAIes generates ensembles with comparable accuracy against experimental NMR and SAXS data, and competitive performance relative to state-of-the-art all-atom simulations and alternative IDP ensemble generation methods. These results demonstrate that bAIes is robust to the choice of structure predictor and that the distance distributions generated by different deep learning architectures contain valuable information about the conformational preferences of disordered proteins. More broadly, our work highlights the potential of combining AI-derived structural information with physics-based modeling to generate atomistic ensembles of intrinsically disordered proteins and regions.

summary.takeaway: 将 bAIes 框架扩展到六种 AI 结构预测工具，利用其预测的残基间距离分布生成 intrinsically disordered proteins 的原子级构象系综；尽管各预测器存在差异，生成的系综与实验 NMR 和 SAXS 数据相比具有可比精度，并与全原子模拟等方法竞争。
summary.methods: 在 AlphaFold2、AlphaFold3、Boltz-1、Boltz-2、ESMFold 和 ESMFold2 的预测距离分布上应用 bAIes，系统比较不同架构编码的结构信息，并用实验 NMR 和 SAXS 数据评估系综准确性，与全原子模拟及替代 IDP 系综生成方法比较。
summary.relevance: 该研究结合 AI 结构预测与物理建模生成无序蛋白构象系综，属于计算生物学中 AI 与分子建模交叉方向，与检索增强与对齐主题下的 AI 结构预测应用相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体精度数值和测试蛋白数量；评估依赖有限实验数据，且未说明各预测器失败模式或计算成本。

papers.title: A chromosome-level genome assembly of the endangered northern dragonhead sap beetle, Thymogethes norvegicus (Easton, 1959)
papers.abstract: The northern dragonhead sap beetle (Thymogethes norvegicus) is believed to be endemic to Norway and is classified as endangered. Its life cycle is closely tied to the host plant northern dragonhead (Dracocephalum ruyschiana), itself classified as vulnerable in Norway. Here, we present a chromosome-level genome assembly of a male T. norvegicus. The assembly comprises two pseudo-haplotypes, hap1 and hap2, of 1,142 and 1,109 Mb, with 96.3% and 96.8% scaffolded into chromosomes, respectively. Hap1 contains 8 autosomes and the X chromosome, while hap2 contains 8 autosomes. Assembly quality was high, with conserved single-copy ortholog completeness scores of 96.6% and 90.7% and combined k-mer completeness of 98.1%. A total of 13,484 and 12,550 protein-coding genes were annotated in hap1 and hap2, respectively. This assembly provides a valuable genomic resource for the conservation of this endangered endemic species totally dependent on the vulnerable plant, the northern dragonhead.

summary.takeaway: 发布濒危挪威特有甲虫 Thymogethes norvegicus 的染色体水平基因组组装，包含两个单倍型，为保护基因组学提供资源。
summary.methods: 对雄性个体进行测序组装，得到 hap1 和 hap2 两个假单倍型，分别为 1,142 Mb 和 1,109 Mb，96.3% 和 96.8% 锚定到染色体；hap1 含 8 条常染色体和 X 染色体，hap2 含 8 条常染色体；用保守单拷贝直系同源完整性和 k-mer 完整性评估质量，并注释蛋白编码基因。
summary.relevance: 该论文提供濒危物种基因组资源，属于计算生物学和基因组学数据资源，但与检索增强与对齐主题关联较弱。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅描述组装与注释指标，未涉及种群遗传分析或保护应用；单一个体组装无法代表物种全貌。

papers.title: S-palmitoylation at the interface between lipophagy and macrophage immunometabolism in sepsis: mechanistic evidence and translational questions.
papers.abstract: Sepsis seldom presents as a uniform immune phenotype. Inflammation and immune suppression often overlap, but their balance shifts across patients, organs, and illness stages. Macrophages sit within this variation, coordinating cytokine output, microbial clearance, antigen processing, and presentation. Lipophagy removes lipid droplets through selective autophagy. The released fatty acids can feed mitochondrial β-oxidation, helping macrophages balance lipid storage with energy demand. Reduced flux may instead leave excess droplets, compromise mitochondrial function, and blunt antimicrobial activity. Whether this sequence directly drives sepsis-associated immunoparalysis remains uncertain. Protein S-palmitoylation offers a second potential control point through reversible cysteine S-acylation. Studies have linked this modification to ATG16L1 and ATG4B, and to immune regulators including MYD88, NLRP3, and CD80. Most of that evidence, however, comes from models other than sepsis, so its relevance cannot be assumed. This review therefore examines the proposed links among macrophage lipophagy, immunometabolic failure, and sepsis-associated immunoparalysis while keeping experimentally established observations separate from mechanistic inference. Taken together, current findings support S-palmitoylation as a plausible regulatory layer, but they do not establish an integrated causal axis linking S-palmitoylation, lipophagy, and immunometabolism in sepsis. This framework awaits direct testing in primary macrophages, organ-specific sepsis models, and longitudinal clinical cohorts.

summary.takeaway: 综述巨噬细胞脂自噬、免疫代谢与脓毒症免疫麻痹之间的可能联系，并讨论 S-棕榈酰化作为潜在调控层；作者明确指出当前证据尚不足以建立 S-棕榈酰化—脂自噬—免疫代谢的整合因果轴。
summary.methods: 叙述性综述，梳理脂自噬清除脂滴、脂肪酸供给线粒体 β-氧化等机制，以及 S-棕榈酰化与 ATG16L1、ATG4B、MYD88、NLRP3、CD80 等因子的关联；强调多数证据来自非脓毒症模型，并将实验确立的观察与机制推断分开陈述。
summary.relevance: 该文涉及机制推理和证据整合，讨论如何区分实验观察与因果推断，与“机制推理”主题相关。
summary.caveat: 作为综述，不提供新的实验数据；核心因果链尚未在原代巨噬细胞、器官特异性脓毒症模型和纵向临床队列中直接检验。

papers.title: Perturbation-induced gene programs map the hidden regulatory architecture of complex diseases
papers.abstract: Steady-state molecular profiles incompletely capture the regulatory programs through which genetic variation influences complex disease, particularly programs that emerge only when cells are perturbed. Here, we introduce Perturbscape, a computational framework that learns multiscale gene programs for individual perturbations in a CRISPR Perturb-seq screen using linear and nonlinear contrastive approaches alongside complementary program-learning methods, and integrates them with human genetics to prioritize disease-relevant genes, perturbations and downstream regulatory pathways. Across 15,859 perturbation-by-context profiles from 7 Perturb-seq systems and 53 complex diseases and traits (mean GWAS N=291K), perturbation-induced programs showed up to 4.3-fold higher heritability informativeness than analogous steady-state multi-tissue gene prioritization, and retained significant conditional heritability informativeness across all 34 matched cell system-trait comparisons after accounting for steady-state prioritization. Preserving perturbation-specific programs further yielded 2.5-5.3-fold higher trait relevance scores than programs derived from control cells, pooled perturbations or differential-expression summaries. In K562, Perturbscape-prioritized genes showed stronger enrichment for rare-variant burden genes than steady-state prioritization and were supported by orthogonal enhancer CRISPRi screens. In HepG2, LDL cholesterol-associated perturbation-induced programs specifically revealed statin-responsive pathways not significantly enriched by steady-state PoPS prioritization, supported by pharmacological transcriptional responses and population plasma proteomics. Perturbscape also recovered blood-related trait-conditioned trans-regulatory relationships that were specifically supported by population trans-eQTLs in IFN-gamma-stimulated monocytes (OR = 1.30, P=1.6e-05). Perturbscape further revealed developmental-stage-specific convergence between monogenic diabetes regulators and polygenic T2D risk during pancreatic islet differentiation, and neuronal-subclass-specific autism-associated regulatory programs in vivo. Together, these findings establish perturbation-induced gene programs as a complementary layer of disease-relevant regulatory information, revealing genetically informative pathways and context-specific regulatory relationships incompletely represented by steady-state molecular atlases.

summary.takeaway: 该研究提出 Perturbscape 计算框架，从 CRISPR Perturb-seq 筛选数据中为单个扰动学习多尺度基因程序，并将其与人类遗传学整合，用于优先排序疾病相关基因、扰动及下游调控通路；结果表明扰动诱导的基因程序可提供稳态分子图谱之外、与疾病遗传信息相关的补充性调控信息。
summary.methods: 使用线性和非线性对比学习方法以及互补的程序学习方法来学习 Perturbscape 基因程序；数据涵盖 7 个 Perturb-seq 系统的 15,859 个扰动-上下文谱，以及 53 种复杂疾病和性状（GWAS 平均 N=291K）；并与人类遗传学数据整合，在 K562、HepG2 及胰腺胰岛分化、体内神经元等情境中评估优先排序结果。
summary.relevance: 与单细胞扰动主题直接相关：该工作利用 Perturb-seq 扰动筛选数据建模扰动诱导的基因程序，并连接复杂疾病遗传学，体现单细胞扰动实验数据在疾病调控解读中的用途。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告的是基于现有 Perturb-seq 系统和 GWAS 数据的计算整合与富集/优先排序结果，不是实验因果验证；多数支持来自正交筛选、药理转录响应、群体蛋白组和 eQTL 等间接证据，具体适用性和机制仍需进一步验证。
